noteGrp.note: Nestorius' only surviving full-length work, written in 451 or 452. Although composed in Greek, it survives only in a single considerably damaged Syriac manuscript from Kotchanes dated approximately to the 12th century, from which four other copies were produced in the 19th century. The work's content is divided into two major sections titled the dialogue and Apology, respectively. The authorship of the first section has been disputed.
